claims.source_quote_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ تَتَعَلَّقَ «فِي» بِالْبُشْرَى، وَأَنْ تَكُونَ حَالًا مِنْهَا
claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تتعلق «في» في عبارة «فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ» بالخبر/الفعل (كمحل جر متعلق) أو أن تعمل حالًا من الخبر/البشرى.
claims.claim_en: The preposition 'في' may either be attached to the predicate/verb (i.e. function as a locative complement related to the predicate) or function as a hal (adverbial circumstance). Applied to this verse, 'في' in 'في ديارهم جاثمين' can be analyzed as either attached to the predicate (linked to 'أصبحوا') or as a circumstantial hal.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source gives a general permissive rule for the preposition «في» but does not state explicitly which of the two readings is adopted for this specific verse; application to this ayah thus requires editorial/grammatical judgment.
